import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Filter for Q1 in years 2024 and 2025
df_q1 = df[(df['quarter'] == 1) & (df['year'].isin([2024, 2025]))]

# Group by month and year, summing the price (sales)
sales_comparison = df_q1.groupby(['month', 'year'])['price'].sum().unstack()

# Reindex to ensure all months 1, 2, 3 are present
sales_comparison = sales_comparison.reindex([1, 2, 3]).fillna(0)

# Plotting
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
sales_comparison.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax, color=['#2b5c8f', '#f97316'], width=0.6)

ax.set_title('Q1 Coffee Sales Comparison: 2024 vs 2025', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_xlabel('Month', fontsize=12, labelpad=8)
ax.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12, labelpad=8)
ax.set_xticklabels(['January', 'February', 'March'], rotation=0, fontsize=11)
ax.legend(title='Year', labels=['2024', '2025'], frameon=True, facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

# Styling ticks and spines
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='both', length=0)
for spine in ['top', 'right', 'left']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#cccccc')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('chart_v2.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()
</execute_python>
